ne-county-officials.summary: The County card names the county you picked, and not its commissioners or other elected officers. The card says so rather than leave the offices looking empty.
ne-county-officials.why: No statewide list of Nebraska's county officials has been read for this app yet, and the counties' own pages have not been read one by one.
ne-county-officials.wanted: One statewide list of each county's commissioners and other elected officers, or a county's own published list of them.

ne-municipal-officeholders.summary: The City or Village card names the city or village you picked, and not its mayor, council or village board.
ne-municipal-officeholders.why: No statewide list of the elected officials of Nebraska's cities and villages has been read for this app, and their own pages have not been read one by one.
ne-municipal-officeholders.wanted: One statewide list of each city or village's mayor, council or village board, or a city or village's own published list of them.

ne-school-board-members.summary: The School District card names the district you picked, and not the members of its school board.
ne-school-board-members.why: No list of the members of Nebraska's school boards has been read for this app, and the districts' own pages have not been read one by one.
ne-school-board-members.wanted: One statewide list of each school district's board members, or a district's own published list of its board.
